integrity: The global bound is derived analytically from a pure-product separable decomposition and singular-value inequalities. The equality classification uses a polar partial-isometry witness to force any saturating decomposition to at most two distinct product states, followed by the prior rank-two classification. The packaged verifier checks only exact algebraic consequences and is not used as a substitute for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to separable two-qubit states and normalized squared Hilbert--Schmidt geometric discord measured on the first qubit. No monotonicity claim for this discord under arbitrary local channels, no higher-dimensional extension, and no statement about entropic, trace-distance, or Bures discord is made. Bibliographic searches reduce but cannot eliminate the risk of a differently phrased later proof.
title: A nuclear-norm proof of the maximal separable two-qubit geometric discord
